title.narrative: FDB Climate Finance and FX Strategies

description.narrative: Agence Francais de Developpement (AFD) would like GGGI to assist Fiji Development Bank to develop a Climate Finance Strategy and a Foreign Exchange Risk Management Strategy.AFD are providing a concessional finance facility (a Guarantee Scheme) to Fiji Development Bank (FDB). As a requirement of the facility, FDB is to develop these two strategies. The FX risk management strategy is driven by FDB’s potential expansion of climate finance in offshore currencies (USD, EURO, AUD). AFD have discussed the scope of works with FDB and GGGI, separately. The scope of works shared by AFD with GGGI is attached as a Documentin this approval.AFD is yet to set up a three-way conversation to co-design the technical assistance. A timeframe and budget has not been discussed yet. AFD havesaid that they would like to launch this project soon (in mid year) but there appears some delays in the discussions with FDB.
